plan.hypothesis: If path '/static/..%5c..%5csecret.txt' reaches cleanup without the relevant check, the safe property fails: Returns exactly '/secret.txt': no .. segment and no backslash remain in the cleaned path

control.seam: Call the real PathTraversal#cleanup on an instance wrapping a stub Rack app
control.property_to_assert: Returns exactly '/static/app.css' Observed by: assert_equal on the String returned by the real cleanup call

citations.quote:
def cleanup(path)
        if path.respond_to?(:encoding)
          # Ruby 1.9+ M17N
          encoding = path.encoding
          dot   = '.'.encode(encoding)
          slash = '/'.encode(encoding)
          backslash = '\\'.encode(encoding)
        else
          # Ruby 1.8
          dot   = '.'
          slash = '/'
          backslash = '\\'
        end

        parts     = []
        unescaped = path.gsub(/%2e/i, dot).gsub(/%2f/i, slash).gsub(/%5c/i, backslash)
        unescaped = unescaped.gsub(backslash, slash)

        unescaped.split(slash).each do |part|
          next if part.empty? or part == dot
          part == '..' ? parts.pop : parts << part
        end

        cleaned = slash + parts.join(slash)
        cleaned << slash if parts.any? and unescaped =~ %r{/\.{0,2}$}
